sentences.text:
Prohibition Act vs In Re : Chandreyi Biswas Dutta on 26
September, 2025
Author: Suvra Ghosh

Bench: Suvra Ghosh
September 26, 2025 3 Ardr (Dnp) Crm (Db) 68 of 2025 In Re : An Application for bail under
Section 483(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in connection with All Women
Police Station, Kharagpur (Town) Case No. 75 of 2021 dated 18/11/2021 under Sections
498A/323/307/406/506/509 /34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry
Prohibition Act.
And In Re : Chandreyi Biswas Dutta ... Petitioner.
Adv. Dhanasree Biswas, ... for the petitioner.
Adv. Faria Hossain, Adv. Soumya Basu Roy Chowdhury, ...for the State.
Learned counsel for the petitioner does not intend to proceed with the matter any further.
In view of the above, the application is dismissed for non- prosecution.
Urgent certified website copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.
